data_quality.cost_handling: cost_usd is treated as accumulated cell cost and divided by usable trials; train means are used for routing decisions.

limitations: This is a diagnostic proxy, not official Router V2 training or a production artifact.
The grid has sparse/asymmetric model coverage; scored routing metrics are conditional on a usable selected cell.
Truncated and zero-trial cells are excluded rather than treated as failures.
The grid has no reliable latency or output-token fields, so this report cannot evaluate latency or token efficiency.
The corpus has no general/code lane labels, so this proxy reports one unified lane.
The itemwise oracle uses realized outcomes and is an optimistic upper bound, not a deployable policy.
No Router V2 environment flag, registry entry, or runtime artifact is changed by this script.

method.model: one deterministic ridge-logistic success head per model
method.routing_rule: choose the lowest expected-cost candidate whose predicted success is at least the threshold; otherwise choose the highest predicted success
method.threshold_selection: validation-only Pareto knee over observed success and observed cost, requiring the configured minimum scored coverage

split_definition.note: The 2024 vintage is an eval-grid diagnostic holdout. It is not the frozen Router V2 study test split.
